purpose: Field contract for source-traceable Watch Tower cable/edge topology and operational cable-state definitions. Exact target-node mapping remains held until attributable current FreeCAD extraction.

fields.name: From_Node
fields.description: Stable source node ID. A family/state profile may use an explicit group token.

fields.name: To_Node
fields.description: Stable destination node ID or explicit unresolved token such as TARGET_FCSTD_UNRESOLVED.

fields.name: Edge_Class
fields.description: Primary cable family, pole/interface family, perimeter family, failure case or state definition.

fields.name: Mirror_Group
fields.description: Mirror/symmetry QA grouping; not a substitute for source coordinates.

fields.name: Quantity_or_Faces
fields.description: Explicit quantity/faces or FCStd-defined unresolved cardinality.

fields.name: Geometry_Rule
fields.description: Endpoint line-of-sight rule plus catenary/sag or other source-backed geometry rule.

fields.name: Operational_State
fields.description: NOMINAL, WEATHER_SLACK, SAFETY_RELAX, CABLE_LOSS_N1, MAINTENANCE_ISOLATED or explicit unresolved state.

fields.name: Evidence_State
fields.description: Owner-current start node, target open, derived test case, schema-ready or other controlled state.

fields.name: Twin_State
fields.description: Gated state such as HOLD-ENDPOINT, SCHEMA-READY, G3-HOLD or G5-HOLD.

fields.name: Active_Default
fields.description: Whether the row is active by default in a twin state; source-unresolved edges remain false.

edge_invariants: WT-A-F1 through WT-A-F4 and WT-C-F1 through WT-C-F4 are valid current tower-face source anchors.
No exact face-anchor-to-wing-pole target may be invented before current FCStd extraction.
Primary cable geometry is not a rigid straight-member assumption; equilibrium/sag must be derived from endpoint geometry and later cable properties.
Cable visual count must derive from the resolved edge graph rather than an artistic render.
WT-E remains a physical node with unresolved adjacency until extracted.
Left/right perimeter families do not assert an all-to-all pole connection.

state_profiles.description: Normal engineered equilibrium state after cable properties and pretension are defined.
Environment-dependent state allowing additional sag/slack only where the engineered envelope permits.
Controlled relaxation/isolation state only where residual stability and exclusion logic are proven.
Failure-screening state removing one defined cable or cable pair and re-equilibrating the system.
Inspection/replacement state with temporary stability, access and vegetation-clearance controls.

guardrails: Numeric pretension, diameter, grade, damping and sag values are intentionally absent until engineering/source evidence exists.
No autonomous cable release or active safety mechanism is assumed by the state model.
Living growth/support interfaces must not obscure structural cable terminations, inspection zones or replacement paths.
Simulation outputs remain screening evidence until mapped to calibrated physical/assembly validation.
